order_note: No predecessor. SQL 173 creates one table and two functions and replaces nothing (owner 2026-11-23, "Proceed with the per job build. Make sure it is for insurance jobs and cash jobs"; step 3 of the per-job design: job costs paid outside ChecksOps, such as materials on a supplier account, card purchases, permits, dumpsters and labor, recorded against an insurance job or a cash job so per-job profit includes them). public.job_expenses (tenant_id; exactly one of claim_id, a foreign key to public.claims(id), and cash_job_id, a foreign key to public.cash_jobs(id), both ON DELETE CASCADE; category materials, labor, subcontractor, permit, equipment or other; amount_cents 1 to 100000000000; expense_date; paid_to <= 200; paid_by NULL or company_card, supplier_account, cash, check, ach or other; notes <= 2000; receipt_path <= 500; created_by, created_at, updated_at; soft delete deleted_at, deleted_by; idempotency_key unique per tenant where present; two partial indexes for a job's live expenses), RLS on (not forced), one SELECT policy aws_select_job_expenses TO authenticated in the form of aws/rls/sql/12_final_select_policies.sql (aws_is_cross_tenant_reader() OR aws_can_access_tenant(tenant_id)), no write policy, every non-owner grant revoked (default privileges included, as SQL 118 and SQL 141) and SELECT granted to checksops and authenticated only. Two SECURITY DEFINER functions, plpgsql, VOLATILE, search_path public, row_security off, EXECUTE checksops and the owner (revoked from PUBLIC, anon, authenticated and service_role): aws_job_expense_add(uuid, uuid, uuid, text, bigint, date, text, text, text, text, text, uuid) returning jsonb (p_user_id must be auth.uid() and a member of the tenant by SQL 90's aws_can_write_tenant, as SQL 147, else 42501 job_expense_forbidden; inputs 22023 job_expense_invalid; the claim must be the tenant's by the API's claimBelongsToTenant rule, org_id the tenant, or org_id NULL and one of the tenant's checks carries the claim, and the cash job by its tenant_id, else P0002 job_expense_job_not_found; the same idempotency key returns the recorded row with duplicate true, a different expense under it is 23505 job_expense_key_reused) and aws_job_expense_delete(uuid, uuid, uuid) returning boolean (soft delete of one of the tenant's live expenses, members only). The file refuses (55000) sql173_prerequisite_missing (claims, cash_jobs, check_intake_items, tenant_users, the columns the functions read, aws_can_write_tenant(uuid), aws_can_access_tenant(uuid), aws_is_cross_tenant_reader(), auth.uid(), gen_random_uuid(), roles checksops and authenticated), sql173_definer_cannot_read (the applying login must own claims, cash_jobs and check_intake_items without FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, or be a superuser or BYPASSRLS; the engine's definer_can_write_relations) and sql173_unexpected_table (a job_expenses table with other columns); a table with these columns but another shape is refused by the engine (created_tables_absent_or_intended). The applying login owns the new table and functions (created_tables_owned_by_login, functions_owned_by_login). No existing table, column, constraint, trigger, policy, grant or row changes (the two foreign keys add only PostgreSQL's internal referential triggers on claims and cash_jobs). Expected pre-state in both environments: the table, its policy and both functions absent (release sql173 v1: 4cc4506d60b103ff058ea7ed83009159e501ac46b03165a6dc0dc11dae8f5df2, releaseStateHash('sql173', {})). The API route that calls the functions and the website that shows a job's expenses and per-job profit are later, separate changes (a Lambda overlay and a website upload, after this pin is applied in production). No API, Lambda or SPA change is part of this pin.
